captureClockSource: max(lastSeen) across the sampled story:track:v1 rows
eligibility: Rows reached by a bounded SCAN of story:track:v1:* whose firstSeen field is present. populationAggregates covers every sampled row. The retained rows keep every scarce-stratum row plus a per-severity cap (critical and low uncapped, high 200, medium 200, info 300).
purpose: Frozen production evidence for issue #7081 — whether StoryPhase.FADING can be derived from the documented "currentScore < 0.5 * peakScore" rule, and whether any bounded alternative meets the acceptance bar.
sanitization: No titles, links, descriptions, or feed/publisher names. Numeric features, severity class, category and language only. Timestamps are offsets in hours from captureUtc, never absolute clock values.

keys: story:track:v1:<titleHash> — HMGET firstSeen lastSeen mentionCount currentScore peakScore severity category lang publishedAt entityCorroborationCount

strataDefinitions.active_high_severity: serving_now and severity critical or high — the control group that must never be labelled fading
strataDefinitions.low_severity_followup: severity info/low with 2+ appearances — the low-severity follow-up adverse example
strataDefinitions.renewed_after_a_day: serving_now but first seen 24h+ ago — renewed coverage, an adverse example
strataDefinitions.serving_now: lastSeen within 30 min of capture — the population derivePhase actually runs on
strataDefinitions.silent_over_24h: no appearance for 24h+ — what the notification seeder already calls fading
